AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / MOOD STANDARD

Lakeside Bench

01 / 10

Atmosphere

The approved summer anchor: calm
water, tree shade, white T-shirt, and close
everyday distance.

Generation Notes
Preserve the
relaxed seated
posture.
Use this page as
the mood
standard for the
rest of the
booklet.

Lakeside Bench
situation-daybook-lakeside-bench-cover

Keep the image
free of
intentional
writing.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Footbridge Breeze

02 / 10

Atmosphere

A breezy footbridge pause that keeps the
summer shade while changing the
silhouette and setting.

Generation Notes
Bridge railings
should read
clearly as the
scene anchor.
Shoes and lower
legs must remain
connected and
complete.

Footbridge Breeze
situation-daybook-footbridge-breeze

Hair and shirt
movement can
imply a light
breeze.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Convenience Walk

03 / 10

Atmosphere

A bright summer errand scene that keeps
the outfit simple and unbranded.

Generation Notes
No package,
sign, or store
writing in the
image.
Keep the walking
pose stable with
visible feet.

Convenience Walk
situation-daybook-convenience-walk

Use bright
pavement
without harsh
overexposure.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Dock Edge

04 / 10

Atmosphere

A calm dock-side composition that gives
the booklet a stronger water-surface
variation.

Generation Notes
Let the open
water and dock
edge carry the
composition.
Do not crop hair,
hands, or shoes.

Dock Edge
situation-daybook-dock-edge

Avoid making the
scene read as
another path
walk.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Park Steps

05 / 10

Atmosphere

A seated park variation that tests
grounded feet and relaxed knees.

Generation Notes
Review seated
anatomy before
acceptance.
Keep the gray
bottom and
white T-shirt
readable.

Park Steps
situation-daybook-park-steps

Ground both
shoes with a
clear shadow.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Window Seat

06 / 10

Atmosphere

A quiet indoor summer page that changes
light without changing the character core.

Generation Notes
Use soft side
light from the
window.
White T-shirt
remains the
outfit anchor.

Window Seat
situation-daybook-window-seat

Keep room props
simple and free
of writing.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Rain-Cooled Street

07 / 10

Atmosphere

A damp summer street scene that cools
the palette while staying gentle.

Generation Notes
Keep reflections
subtle.

A thin cardigan is
allowed only if
the white T-shirt
still leads.

Rain-Cooled Street
situation-daybook-rain-cooled-street

Avoid umbrellas,
shop signs, and
posters with
writing.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Station After Sun

08 / 10

Atmosphere

A late-afternoon waiting scene with warm
rim light and quiet transit context.

Generation Notes
No station-name
or timetable
writing
dependency.
Use a thin outer
layer only as a
light variation.

Station After Sun
situation-daybook-station-after-sun

Keep the waiting
pose relaxed.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Vending Machine Night

09 / 10

Atmosphere

A quiet night page that swaps sunlight for
practical cool light.

Generation Notes
Vending details
must remain
unreadable as
writing.
Do not let
machine
graphics
compete with
Akari.

Vending Machine Night
situation-daybook-vending-machine-night

Balance cool
light with warm
skin tones.

AKARI V1.1 SITUATION DAYBOOK / LIGHT NOTES

Golden Hour Return

10 / 10

Atmosphere

A closing return-path scene with warm
backlight and long shadows.

Generation Notes
Keep outfit
silhouette
readable against
sunset.
Maintain the
same calm
everyday
distance as the
cover.

Golden Hour Return
situation-daybook-golden-hour-return

Use long
shadows without
hiding shoes.
